sentences.text: Shri Atul Gupta - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Samar Ghuraiya - Public Prosecutor for respondent/S Heard on I.A.No.3719/2026, an application for grant of temporary suspension of sentence and bail on behalf of appellant - Arab @ Sandeep Sharma on the ground of attending marriage of his sister.

2. This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 27.09.2024 passed in S.C No.204/2022whereby present appellant has been convicted under Section 366, 376(1) of IPC and Section 3/4 (1) of POCSO Act and sentenced to suffer 10 years' RI, 10 years' RI and 10 years' RI with fine of Rs.500/-,
Rs.500/- and Rs.500/- respectively with usual default stipulations.

3 . It is the submission of learned counsel for the appellant that marriage of his sister is going to be solemnized on 11.03.2026 and being brother, appellant has to perform some rituals in the marriage,
therefore
, he may kindly be granted interim suspension for a period of 10 days, so that he can attend marriage of his sister.

4 . Factum regarding marriage of sister of appellant has been verified by the State counsel, however,
he submits that if this Court intends to release the appellant for the time being, then looking to the nature of allegations, certain stringent conditions may kindly be imposed upon him.
2 CRA-11559-2024 5. Considering the aforesaid submissions, the application is allowed.

Upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court/CJM Court/Remand Court, the jail sentence of appellant- Arab @ Sandeep Sharma shall remain temporarily suspended.
He shall be released on temporary bail from the date of his release till 15.03.2026.
The appellant shall surrender immediately on or before 15.03.2026 before the concerned Trial Court/Remand Court, and a report regarding the said fact shall be sent to this Court.

6 . It is made clear that during release, appellant shall not be a source of harassment/
embarrassment to the complainant side in any manner.
